Q: How to intercept a markdown file and display as HTML? A:

I ran into the same issue after upgrading to Qt 6.10. Calling setHtml() directly inside acceptNavigationRequest() caused random crashes for me (exit code 133). After some digging, it looks like webengine is still processing the navigation at that point, so changing the page content synchronously isn’t safe anymore. What worked for me was blocking the navigation and deferring setHtml() to the event loop using QTimer.singleShot(0, ...). Once I did that, the crashes stopped. For more complex setups, a custom QWebEngineUrlSchemeHandler is probably the cleaner solution, but for just intercepting local .md files this approach has been fine so far.

Q: Ant <script> task failing with GraalJS after migrating to Java 17 A:

nashorn js version

  • create directory: lib
  • download javascript nashorn engine jar file to lib directory
    • https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/org.openjdk.nashorn/nashorn-core/15.7
    • https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/org.ow2.asm/asm/7.3.1
    • https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/org.ow2.asm/asm-commons/7.3.1
    • https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/org.ow2.asm/asm-util/7.3.1
    • https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/org.ow2.asm/asm-tree/7.3.1

Project tree:

hello-ant
├── build.xml
├── lib
│   ├── asm-7.3.1.jar
│   ├── asm-commons-7.3.1.jar
│   ├── asm-tree-7.3.1.jar
│   ├── asm-util-7.3.1.jar
│   └── nashorn-core-15.7.jar

build.xml

  • add <path id="nashorn.classpath">...
  • change <script language="javascript" classpathref="nashorn.classpath">
<project name="HelloWorld" default="run" basedir=".">
...
    <property name="lib.dir" value="lib"/>

    <path id="nashorn.classpath">
        <fileset dir="." includes="${lib.dir}/*.jar" erroronmissingdir="false"/>
    </path>
...
    <target name="test">
        <echo message="Using jars from ${lib.dir} for Nashorn..."/>
        <script language="javascript" classpathref="nashorn.classpath">
            <![CDATA[
            var System = Java.type("java.lang.System");
            print("Java OK: " + System.currentTimeMillis());
            ]]>
        </script>        
    </target>
...

test

$ ant test
Buildfile: ....hello-ant\build.xml

test:
     [echo] Using jars from lib for Nashorn...
   [script] Java OK: 1766817481360

BUILD SUCCESSFUL
Total time: 0 seconds

Q: How to disable the warning of Unnecessary Using of Directive in vscode? A:

change

<Nullable>enabled</Nullable> to <Nullable>disable</Nullable>

in the file

YOUR_PROJECT.csproj

It's on the root directory of your project.

Q: Generate new SSH Key in Git GUI A:

To modify the existing default ssh key, you don't need to gui.

Make sure your <git>\usr\bin is in %PATH% and type:

ssh-keygen -t rsa -C "key for xxx access" -q -P ""

That will propose to override your %HOME%\.ssh\id_rsa(.pub) (with %HOME% generally set to %USERPROFILE%)
